angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,131,904 km at 300.92 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 3.3231 +/- 0.0194 mas (same row, RUWE 1.24): 300.92 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.627 +/- 0.062 solar radii from Addison et al. 2016, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-87 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...823...29A/abstract): 1,131,904 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.204 +/- 0.093 solar masses from Addison et al. 2016, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-87 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...823...29A/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6450 +/- 120 K from Addison et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-87 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...823...29A/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Addison et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-87 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...823...29A/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-87.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.096, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, CD-52 4998: main object type *, Star
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-87 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.53683, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6077185317188247936, flags_flame 00: age_flame 3.1150513 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 2.6563914 to 3.5745268)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-87 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 9.9 km/s, from Addison et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...823...29A/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
